verdict.rationale: Turso docs show some building blocks for migration — opening existing SQLite files directly (turso-docs-30), dumping a production DB for local use (turso-docs-29, turso-docs-47), and creating a new DB branch `--from-db` an existing database (turso-docs-18) — but there is no dedicated, documented end-to-end migration guide addressing downtime, cutover, or importing from non-Turso production systems (e.g., Postgres/MySQL). Missing for 10: a documented step-by-step production migration/cutover guide, downtime guarantees or minimization strategy, and any independent/hands-on report of a real production migration succeeding.
